scripts.build: bun run clean && bun build src/background/service-worker.ts src/content/content-script.ts src/pages/sidepanel.ts src/pages/library.ts src/pages/options.ts --outdir dist/src --target browser && bun run copy-static
scripts.copy-static: mkdir -p dist/src/pages dist/src/ui && cp -R extension/. dist/ && cp src/pages/*.html dist/src/pages/ && cp src/ui/styles.css dist/src/ui/styles.css
